verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a first-party Dropbox developer blog entry titled "Uploading file data in a performant manner" (dropbox-docs-21), alongside generic Files API create/read docs (dropbox-docs-3). Nothing in the pack explicitly describes chunked upload sessions or resuming after a dropped connection, so this is thin, glancing support. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of chunked upload session endpoints (start/append/finish), documented resume-after-disconnect behavior, size limits per chunk, SDK examples of session uploads, and independent or hands-on corroboration of reliability for large files.
